examples.description: Create an isolated profile that still needs model and credential setup.

examples.description: Use coder as the source instead of the active profile.

details.whenToUse: Create a separate Hermes agent for a role, project, identity, credential set, or messaging gateway without mixing its state with another profile.
prerequisites: Choose a unique profile name made from letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

parameters.name: <name>
parameters.description: Name for the new profile. Must be a valid directory name (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

parameters.name: --clone
parameters.description: Copy config.yaml, .env, SOUL.md, and skills from the current profile.

parameters.name: --clone-all
parameters.description: Copy everything (config, memories, skills, cron, plugins) from the current profile. Excludes per-profile history: sessions, state.db, backups, state-snapshots, checkpoints.

parameters.name: --clone-from <profile>
parameters.description: Clone config/skills/SOUL from a specific profile instead of the current one. Implies --clone unless paired with --clone-all.

parameters.name: --no-alias
parameters.description: Skip wrapper script creation.

parameters.name: --description "<text>"
parameters.description: One- or two-sentence description of what this profile is good at. Used by the kanban orchestrator to route tasks based on role instead of profile name alone. Skip and add later via hermes profile describe. Persisted in <profile_dir>/profile.yaml.

parameters.name: --no-skills
parameters.description: Create an empty profile with zero bundled skills enabled. Writes a .no-bundled-skills marker into the profile so future hermes update runs won't re-seed the bundled set, and refuses to combine with --clone, --clone-from, or --clone-all (which would copy skills in anyway). Useful for narrow orchestrator profiles or sandbox profiles that should not inherit the full skill catalog. To toggle this on an already-created profile (including the default ~/.hermes), use hermes skills opt-out / hermes skills opt-in.

workflow.title: 1. Create the profile
workflow.description: Clone the current setup or omit --clone to start blank.

workflow.title: 2. Configure models and tools
workflow.description: Run setup explicitly inside the new profile.

workflow.title: 3. Set its project directory
workflow.description: Profiles isolate state; terminal.cwd separately controls where shell commands begin.

workflow.title: 4. Validate the profile
workflow.description: Check credentials, providers, dependencies, and runtime configuration.

workflow.title: 5. Start using it
workflow.description: Use -p for an explicit one-command selection or run work chat through its generated alias.

notes: Use --clone for shared configuration with fresh sessions and memory.
Use --clone-all only when you need a fuller snapshot; per-profile history remains excluded.

items.name: hermes profile describe
items.description: Read or set a profile's description. The description is consumed by the kanban orchestrator to route tasks based on what each profile is good at, rather than guessing from the profile name alone. Persisted in <profile_dir>/profile.yaml so it survives reboots and is shared with the gateway.

details.whenToUse: Read or set a profile's description. The description is consumed by the kanban orchestrator to route tasks based on what each profile is good at, rather than guessing from the profile name alone. Persisted in <profile_dir>/profile.yaml so it survives reboots and is shared with the gateway.

parameters.name: <name>
parameters.description: Profile to describe. Required unless --all --auto is used.

parameters.name: --text "<text>"
parameters.description: Set the description to this exact text (user-authored). Overwrites any existing description.

parameters.name: --auto
parameters.description: Auto-generate a 1-2 sentence description via the auxiliary LLM, based on the profile's installed skills, configured model, and name. Configure the model under auxiliary.profile_describer in config.yaml. Auto-generated descriptions are marked description_auto: true so the dashboard can flag them for review.

parameters.name: --overwrite
parameters.description: With --auto, replace user-authored descriptions too (default: skip profiles whose description was set explicitly).

parameters.name: --all
parameters.description: With --auto, sweep every profile missing a description.

items.name: hermes skills check

items.name: hermes skills config

items.name: hermes skills inspect <identifier>

items.name: hermes skills install <identifier>
items.description: Install a skill from a registry, repository, or direct SKILL.md URL.

items.name: hermes skills list
items.description: List installed skills.

items.name: hermes skills publish
items.description: Publish a skill to a configured registry.

items.name: hermes skills search <query>

items.name: /agents (alias: /tasks)
items.description: Show active agents and running tasks across the current session.

items.name: /approvals [manual|smart|off]
items.description: Show or set the persistent dangerous-command approval mode.

items.name: /background <prompt> (alias: /bg, /btw)
items.description: Run a prompt in a separate background session. The agent processes your prompt independently — your current session stays free for other work. Results appear as a panel when the task finishes. See CLI Background Sessions.

items.name: /battery [on|off|status]
items.description: Toggle a color-coded battery read-out as the first status-bar element (off by default; no-op without a battery).

items.name: /blueprint [name] [slot=value ...] (alias: /bp)
items.description: Set up an automation from a blueprint template. Bare /blueprint lists the catalog; /blueprint <name> starts a guided slot-filling flow on the next agent turn; /blueprint <name> slot=value ... creates the job directly.

items.name: /branch [name] (alias: /fork)
items.description: Branch the current session (explore a different path)

items.name: /browser [connect|disconnect|status]
items.description: Manage a local Chromium-family CDP connection. connect attaches browser tools to a running Chrome, Brave, Chromium, or Edge instance (default: http://127.0.0.1:9222). disconnect detaches. status shows current connection. Auto-launches a supported Chromium-family browser if no debugger is detected.

items.name: /bundles
items.description: List configured skill bundles — /<name> slash aliases that preload several skills at once. Configure under bundles: in ~/.hermes/config.yaml. See Skill Bundles.

items.name: /busy [queue|steer|interrupt|status]
items.description: CLI-only: control what pressing Enter does while Hermes is working — queue the new message, steer mid-turn, or interrupt immediately.

items.name: /clear
items.description: Clear screen and start a new session

items.name: /codex-runtime [auto|codex_app_server|on|off]
items.description: Toggle the optional Codex app-server runtime for OpenAI/Codex models. auto (default) uses Hermes' standard chat completions; codex_app_server hands turns to a codex app-server subprocess for native shell, apply_patch, ChatGPT subscription auth, and migrated Codex plugins. Effective on next session.

items.name: /compress [here [N] | focus topic]
items.description: Manually compress conversation context (flush memories + summarize). /compress here [N] summarizes everything except the most recent N exchanges (default 2), kept verbatim — pick your own compression boundary. A focus topic narrows what a full summary preserves.

items.name: /config
items.description: Show current configuration

items.name: /context [all] (alias: /ctx)
items.description: Visual context-window breakdown. On the CLI/TUI: a 5×20 glyph block grid (each cell ≈ 1% of the model window) plus an estimated per-category table — system prompt, tool definitions, rules, skills index, MCP, subagents, memory, conversation — versus free space. On messaging platforms: a usage gauge with auto-compression threshold/headroom, compression stats, cumulative throughput, and the same category table in plain text. /context all appends per-skill and per-toolset cost listings (index cost vs SKILL.md load cost; schema tokens per toolset). Read-only and computed locally — no LLM call, no prompt-cache impact.

items.name: /copy [number]
items.description: Copy the last assistant response to clipboard (or the Nth-from-last with a number). CLI-only.

items.name: /cron
items.description: Manage scheduled tasks (list, add/create, edit, pause, resume, run, remove)

items.name: /curator
items.description: Background skill maintenance — status, run, pin, archive. See Curator.

items.name: /debug
items.description: Upload debug report (system info + logs) and get shareable links. Also available in messaging.

items.name: /diff [staged|all|session] [--stat] [path...]
items.description: Show git changes in the working directory. Default: unstaged changes plus untracked files. staged shows what's staged for commit, all everything since HEAD, and session the cumulative diff of everything Hermes changed here (from the earliest retained checkpoint baseline — requires checkpoints to be enabled; complements /rollback diff <N>). --stat prints just the changed-file summary; path arguments restrict the diff.

items.name: /egress [status]
items.description: Show Docker egress proxy status — enabled/configured/running state, credential source, token mappings, uncovered providers, and next remediation step. Works in CLI, TUI, Desktop chat, and messaging gateway.

items.name: /fast [normal|fast|status] [--global]
items.description: Toggle fast mode between normal and fast service tiers. Changes are session-scoped by default; use --global to save the selected tier to config.

items.name: /focus [on|off|status]
items.description: Toggle focus view — a display-only reduced-output mode showing just your prompt and the final response. Composes with /verbose: turning it on snaps tool progress to off and remembers your previous mode, and /focus off restores it. Each turn ends with a dim recovery line (⋯ 7 tool lines hidden · /focus off to show) and a persistent ◉ focus badge sits in the status bar so you always know you're in the reduced view. Nothing is sent differently to the model — detail is hidden, never discarded.

items.name: /footer [on|off|status]
items.description: Toggle the gateway runtime-metadata footer on final replies (shows model, context %, and cwd).

items.name: /goal <text>
items.description: Set a standing goal Hermes works toward across turns — our take on the Ralph loop. After each turn an auxiliary judge model decides whether the goal is done; if not, Hermes auto-continues. Subcommands: /goal status, /goal pause, /goal resume, /goal clear. Budget defaults to 20 turns (goals.max_turns); any real user message preempts the continuation loop, and state survives /resume. See Persistent Goals for the full walkthrough.

items.name: /handoff <platform>
items.description: CLI only. Hand the current session off to a messaging platform (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, Matrix). The gateway picks it up immediately, creates a fresh thread on platforms that support threads (Telegram topics, Discord text-channel threads, Slack message-anchored threads), re-binds the destination to your CLI session_id so the full role-aware transcript replays, and forges a synthetic user turn so the agent confirms it's working in the new place. Your CLI exits cleanly on success with a /resume hint; resume locally any time with /resume <title>. Refused mid-turn. Requires the gateway to be running and a home channel configured for the target platform (/sethome from the destination chat). See Cross-Platform Handoff.

items.name: /hatch <description> (alias: /generate-pet)
items.description: Generate a brand-new petdex pet from a text description, using the configured image backend (OpenRouter / Nous Portal). See Pets.

items.name: /help
items.description: Show this help message

items.name: /history
items.description: Show conversation history (respects /timestamps)

items.name: /image <path>
items.description: Attach a local image file for your next prompt.

items.name: /indicator [kaomoji|emoji|unicode|ascii]
items.description: CLI-only: pick the TUI busy-indicator style.

items.name: /init [notes]
items.description: Generate or update AGENTS.md project instructions from a repo scan (port of Codex /init). The agent inspects manifests, layout, and toolchain configs with its read-only tools, then writes a concise AGENTS.md — or, if one exists, merge-updates it preserving your content. Optional notes steer the emphasis. Works in the CLI, the messaging gateway, and the TUI.

items.name: /insights
items.description: Show usage insights and analytics (last 30 days)

items.name: /journey [list|delete <id>|edit <id>] (aliases: /learning, /memory-graph)
items.description: Open the learning journey timeline of learned skills + memories. Works in the classic CLI, as a TUI overlay, and in the desktop app (Star Map panel). Not available on messaging platforms. See Learning Journey.

items.name: /kanban <action>
items.description: Drive the multi-profile, multi-project collaboration board without leaving chat. Full hermes kanban surface is available: /kanban list, /kanban show t_abc, /kanban create "title" --assignee X, /kanban comment t_abc "text", /kanban unblock t_abc, /kanban dispatch, etc. Multi-board support included: /kanban boards list, /kanban boards create <slug>, /kanban boards switch <slug>, /kanban --board <slug> <action>. See Kanban slash command.

items.name: /learn <what to learn from>
items.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything you describe — a directory, a URL, the workflow you just walked the agent through, or pasted notes. Open-ended: the agent gathers the sources with its own tools and authors a SKILL.md following the house authoring standards. Works in the CLI, the messaging gateway, the TUI, and the dashboard Skills page.

items.name: /memory [pending|approve|reject|approval]
items.description: Review pending memory writes staged by the write-approval gate (memory.write_approval) and toggle the gate. See Controlling memory writes.

items.name: /moa <prompt>
items.description: Run a single prompt through the default Mixture of Agents preset, then restore your current model. One-shot — does not change your session model.

items.name: /model [model-name]
items.description: Show or change the current model. Use --provider to switch to an already configured provider, --global to save the default, --session to keep the change session-only, --once for one turn, or --refresh to reload model catalogs. Add providers with hermes model before starting a session. Switching models mid-conversation resets the prompt cache.

examples.title: Session-Only Switch
examples.description: Example only: replace the model and provider with your own values and keep the change session-scoped.

examples.title: Switch and Save Globally
examples.description: Example only: replace the model and provider with your own values, then persist them in config.yaml.

examples.title: One-Turn Switch
examples.description: Example only: replace the model and provider with your own values, use them once, then restore the previous model.

examples.title: Refresh Available Models
examples.description: Refresh provider model catalogs before choosing a model.

items.warning: Switching models mid-conversation resets the prompt cache. The next turn re-reads the conversation at full input price.

items.name: /new [name] (alias: /reset)
items.description: Start a new session (fresh session ID + history). Optional [name] sets the initial session title — e.g. /new my-experiment opens a fresh session already titled my-experiment so it's easy to find later with /resume or /sessions. Append now, --yes, or -y to skip the confirmation modal — e.g. /reset now, /new --yes my-experiment.

items.name: /paste
items.description: Attach a clipboard image

items.name: /personality
items.description: Set a predefined personality

items.name: /pet [list|<slug>]
items.description: Toggle or adopt a petdex mascot. /pet toggles the pane, /pet list shows installed pets, /pet <slug> adopts a specific one.

items.name: /platforms (alias: /gateway)
items.description: Show gateway/messaging platform status (CLI-only summary view).

items.name: /plugins
items.description: List installed plugins and their status

items.name: /profile
items.description: Show active profile name and home directory

items.name: /prompt (alias: /compose)
items.description: Compose your next prompt in $EDITOR (markdown) instead of the inline input — useful for long, multi-line, or carefully-formatted prompts.

items.name: /queue <prompt> (alias: /q)
items.description: Queue a prompt for the next turn (doesn't interrupt the current agent response).

items.name: /quit
items.description: Exit the CLI (also: /exit).

items.name: /reasoning [level|show|hide|full|clamp] [--global]
items.description: Manage reasoning effort and display. Levels include none / minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max / ultra. show / hide (or on / off) toggle reasoning display; full and clamp adjust how reasoning is shown. --global persists effort to config.

items.name: /reload-skills (alias: /reload_skills)
items.description: Re-scan ~/.hermes/skills/ for newly installed or removed skills

items.name: /resume [name]
items.description: Resume a previously-named session

items.name: /retry
items.description: Retry the last message (resend to agent)

items.name: /rollback
items.description: List or restore filesystem checkpoints (usage: /rollback [number])

items.name: /save
items.description: Save the current conversation

items.name: /sessions (TUI alias: /switch)
items.description: Classic CLI: browse and resume previous sessions in an interactive picker. TUI: open the live session switcher for currently open TUI sessions. Use /sessions new in the TUI to start another live session immediately.

items.name: /skills
items.description: Search, install, inspect, or manage skills from online registries. Also the review surface for the skill write-approval gate: /skills pending, /skills diff <id>, /skills approve <id>, /skills reject <id>, /skills approval on|off. See Gating agent skill writes.

items.name: /skin
items.description: Show or change the display skin/theme

items.name: /snapshot [create|restore <id>|prune] (alias: /snap)
items.description: Create or restore state snapshots of Hermes config/state. create [label] saves a snapshot, restore <id> reverts to it, prune [N] removes old snapshots, or list all with no args.

items.name: /status
items.description: Show session info — model, provider, profile, session ID, working directory, title, created/updated timestamps, token totals, agent-running state — followed by a local Session recap block (recent user/assistant turn counts, tool result count, top tools used, last few files touched, the latest user prompt, and the latest assistant reply). The recap is computed locally from the in-memory conversation; no LLM call, no prompt-cache impact.

items.name: /statusbar (alias: /sb)
items.description: Toggle the context/model status bar on or off

items.name: /steer <prompt>
items.description: Inject a mid-run note that arrives at the agent after the next tool call — no interrupt, no new user turn. The text is appended to the last tool result's content once the current tool completes, giving the agent new context without breaking the current tool-calling loop. Use this to nudge direction mid-task (e.g. "focus on the auth module" while the agent is running tests).

items.name: /stop
items.description: Kill all running background processes

items.name: /subgoal <text>
items.description: Append a user-supplied criterion to the active goal mid-loop. The continuation prompt surfaces all subgoals to the agent verbatim, and the judge factors them into its DONE/CONTINUE verdict — so the goal isn't marked done until the original goal and every subgoal are met. Subcommands: /subgoal (list), /subgoal remove <N>, /subgoal clear. Requires an active /goal.

items.name: /subscription (alias: /upgrade)
items.description: CLI only. View your Nous plan and change it in the browser.

items.name: /suggestions [accept|dismiss N|catalog|clear] (alias: /suggest)
items.description: Review suggested automations. Use /suggestions to list pending suggestions, /suggestions accept <id> to create the proposed automation, /suggestions dismiss <id> to reject one, /suggestions catalog to add curated starter automations, and /suggestions clear to clear resolved suggestion records. Accepted jobs preserve the current surface as the delivery origin.

items.name: /timestamps [on|off|status]
items.description: CLI-only: toggle [HH:MM] timestamps on messages and in /history.

items.name: /title
items.description: Set a title for the current session (usage: /title My Session Name)

items.name: /tools [list|disable|enable] [name...]
items.description: Manage tools: list available tools, or disable/enable specific tools for the current session. Disabling a tool removes it from the agent's toolset and triggers a session reset.

items.name: /toolsets
items.description: List available toolsets

items.name: /topup
items.description: Show your Nous balance and manage billing on the portal (replaces the old /credits and /billing commands).

items.name: /undo
items.description: Remove the last user/assistant exchange

items.name: /update
items.description: Update Hermes Agent to the latest version.

items.name: /usage
items.description: Show token usage, cost breakdown, session duration, and — when available from the active provider — an Account limits section with remaining quota / credits / plan usage pulled live from the provider's API.

items.name: /verbose
items.description: Cycle tool progress display: off → new → all → verbose. Can be enabled for messaging via config.

items.name: /version
items.description: Show Hermes Agent version, build, and environment info.

items.name: /voice [on|off|tts|status]
items.description: Toggle CLI voice mode and spoken playback. Recording uses voice.record_key (default: Ctrl+B).

items.name: /wake [on|off|status]
items.description: CLI-only: toggle the "Hey Hermes" wake word listener.

items.name: /whoami
items.description: Show your slash command access level (admin / user).

items.name: /yolo
items.description: Toggle YOLO mode — skip all dangerous command approval prompts.

items.name: /browser connect
items.description: Attach browser tools to a Chromium-family browser over CDP.

items.name: /browser disconnect
items.description: Detach the current local browser connection.

items.name: /tools disable <name>
items.description: Disable one or more tools for the current session.

items.name: /tools enable <name>
items.description: Enable one or more tools for the current session.

items.name: /tools list
items.description: List tools available in the current session.

items.name: hermes computer-use
items.description: Install or check the Computer Use (cua-driver) backend (macOS/Windows/Linux).

items.name: hermes computer-use install
items.description: Install the cua-driver backend for Computer Use.

items.name: hermes computer-use status
items.description: Check whether cua-driver is installed and show its version.

items.name: hermes lsp
items.description: Manage Language Server Protocol integration (semantic diagnostics for write_file/patch).

items.name: hermes setup tools
items.description: Open the tool selection step of the setup wizard.

items.name: hermes tools
items.description: Configure enabled tools per platform.

items.name: hermes tools --summary
items.description: Print the currently enabled toolsets and exit.

items.name: /redraw
items.description: Force a full terminal repaint after resize or rendering drift.

items.name: /reload
items.description: Reload .env values into the active session after adding or changing API keys.

items.name: hermes chat --safe-mode
items.description: Disable user config, rules, memory, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers to isolate customization issues.

items.name: hermes debug
items.description: Upload a debug report with system information and logs for support.

items.name: hermes doctor
items.description: Diagnose configuration, provider, dependency, and runtime issues.

items.name: hermes dump
items.description: Produce a copy-pasteable setup summary for support without exposing secrets.

items.name: hermes logs --tail
items.description: Follow Hermes log output while reproducing a problem.

items.name: hermes prompt-size
items.description: Break down system-prompt and tool-schema size to diagnose context pressure.
